items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: I had the trio. My piano player was Jack LaRue and my guitarist was Leonard Enois, whose nickname was Lucky Enois.

ctx.x: Erroll Garner and I first met... I don't know whether I mentioned this before, but I had a group, a trio, and I think it was a little joint on San Pedro, near Adams, called the Casablanca. I had the trio. My piano player was Jack LaRue and my guitarist was Leonard Enois, whose nickname was Lucky Enois. All these guys are gone, incidentally. But Erroll Garner came in one night, and asked to sit in, and I had never experienced anything like it. Fortunately, I was on his left; I played on his left side. So I spied…
